packageRules.description: Drizzle is pre-1.0 and publishes per-branch snapshots (1.0.0-rc.4-<sha>) alongside real releases. Those sort ABOVE the release in semver prerelease ordering, so Renovate picks them: in July 2026 it moved drizzle-kit onto a snapshot a month older than the release, which no longer matched drizzle-orm and broke migration generation. The two are pinned to a hand-checked working pair. Re-enable once drizzle ships a stable 1.0.0.
